entries.reason: iOS 6 lists the inputs of the route in use and not every input it could use
entries.effect: the inputs of the current route of iOS 6, whose list is the one the release gives for the route in use
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the members and the release that added them; AVAudioSession of iOS 6.0, whose current route lists the inputs in use (the iOS 6.0 emulator lists the built-in microphone for a session of the record category)

entries.reason: iOS 6 cannot choose an input, so a preference is kept only for the input in use
entries.effect: the input set as preferred while it is still an input of the current route, and nil otherwise
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the members and the release that added them; AVAudioSession of iOS 6.0, whose current route lists the inputs in use (the iOS 6.0 emulator lists the built-in microphone for a session of the record category)

entries.reason: iOS 6 cannot choose an input, and the answer is refused and not made up
entries.effect: YES for nil, which clears the preference, and for an input of the current route, which is the input in use; NO with an error of AVAudioSessionErrorCodeResourceNotAvailable for any other input, since iOS 6 has no way to switch to it
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the members and the release that added them; AVAudioSession of iOS 6.0, whose current route lists the inputs in use (the iOS 6.0 emulator lists the built-in microphone for a session of the record category)
